title: Ootle Forge
creator: Mystiy
summary: MIT-licensed collectible-crafting game source and walletless simulation. The proposed Rust template burns EMBER and a forge fee to mint tiered relics, combines three matching relics into a higher tier, and melts duplicates into materials. The admin-badge holder controls fee withdrawals. The README and hosted page explicitly say the template is unpublished on Esmeralda and mainnet. Simulation amounts and NFTs have no real value; creator engine-test claims remain attributed source statements. The source warns that its randomness is game-grade. This recording shows the README and deployment limits; no game or template was executed.
cardSummary: Gather crafting materials, forge collectible relics, combine matching tiers and recycle duplicates in a walletless browser simulation.
